author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
I'm Spain, working very hard, feeling pretty ill, I want some comfort food, so I cobbled this together mostly to make use of some stuff I already had...

Join the Atomic Shrimp official Discord server for early access to videos! - https://discord.gg/atomicshrimp
Atomic Shrimp subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/AtomicShrimp/

'Recipe' notes:
Ingredients

½ Cup rice (I used Redondo, because it's what I had)
1 Cup cream
4 Cups milk 
1 Tablespoon sugar
Handful of golden sultanas
Handful of dried cranberries
4 or 5 dates, stoned and chopped
½ Teaspoon ground cinnamon
Pinch of saffron
3 tablespoons warm water

Method
Put the saffron in the warm water and leave to infuse for at least 10 minutes (longer is better)

Add all of the ingredients to an ovenproof dish and stir

Cover and bake for 40 minutes at 180 Celsius

Uncover, stir and bake for a further 30 minutes, or until the rice is soft

Serve hot, with jam and/or fresh fruit
title: Saffron Rice Pudding (A Cobbled-Together Sort of Dish)
